conviction_note: Near-zero: the one lean (weak H1 progress against a plan this company never revises at H1, and two straight H1 prints with no revision sold off 2.3% and 5.3%) can be worked out by anyone from the Q1 短信, so p_up sits only just under 50 (47) on a 2.2% scale; the findings sum to -0.3 and the scaled number to -0.13, which agree in sign and differ only because the scaled number puts the uncertainty into p_up.
bar: No street consensus, no 四季報 or IFIS number reachable (kabutan premium-gated), so the bar is the company's own FY plan of OP 2,410m yen, unchanged at Q1 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260730502989.pdf, 2026-07-30). The company gives no H1 guide; the H1 bar here is this company's own H1 share of full-year OP (62-65% in FY2023-FY2025, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9046), about 1,500-1,560m yen, against an H1 estimate of about 1,350-1,400m yen if Q2 repeats Q1's cost-driven decline. This bar comes from the company plan and no street number confirms it, so every size here is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-10-28 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the baseline). 信用倍率 0.81 (margin shorts larger than margin longs), from the baseline and kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=9046, read 2026-10-29). The September 優待 record date (last cum-rights day 2026-09-28) makes most of the margin short look like 優待クロス hedging that unwinds, not a crowded bearish bet, so it is weak squeeze fuel. No option skew exists. Run-up: -5.93% over 20 days and -2.43% over 5 days, which is mostly the mechanical ex-優待 drift from 2,465 on 09-28 to 2,255.

findings.finding: Q1 FY2027 OP fell 13.4% to 843m yen (rail OP down 25.5% on personnel and inflation-driven repair costs, while passenger revenue was +0.2%), only 35% of an unchanged FY plan of 2,410m yen against 44-47% at Q1 in the last two years. Q2 is likely to carry the same costs, which puts H1 near 56% of plan against 70-74% at H1 in the last two years. A company that never revises at H1 then either holds a plan that now needs H2 OP up about 20% year on year, or cuts it with this release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 prints, next session (Yahoo daily closes, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/9046.T?range=3y&interval=1d): 2024-10-31 -2.31% (H1 at 74% of plan, plan held), 2025-10-30 -5.30% on 2x normal volume (H1 at 70% of plan, plan held), 2023-10-31 +5.69% (dividend resumed, 復配). Q1 FY2027 print, 2026-07-31: -1.83% on the same weak progress.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the Q1 progress rate is public and the stock fell 1.8% on it and about 10% since 07-30. What is not priced is whether this release ADDS a forecast cut. If the market expected one, the stock would have broken down after Q1 rather than drifting with the ex-優待 pattern, and with no analyst coverage nobody publishes the H2 arithmetic. What is left is a small chance of a cut, offset by relief if the plan is held.
findings.independence: The FY plans and actuals for FY2024 (plan 1,750, actual 2,006) and FY2025 (plan 2,230, actual 2,421, never revised for earnings) come from the 2024-10-30 and 2025-10-29 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251029/140120251029581177.pdf). They show plans are conservative, which cuts against a cut. Same company documents, not an independent series.

findings.finding: No shareholder-return action is likely in this batch: the two latest dividend raises (20 to 25 yen, and the one before) were filed at the Q3 print (2025-02-03 and 2026-01-29), the only H1 action in three years was the 2023-10-30 復配, and treasury stock is flat at about 150k shares, so there is no buyback habit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2023-10-31 +5.69% the session after the H1 print that carried the 復配 notice. The Q3 dividend raises: 2025-02-04 +1.74%, 2026-01-30 +0.08%.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing to price: the base case is no announcement, which leaves the stock where it is. The upside tail is an out-of-pattern 増配 or buyback at a 0.69x PBR, which TSE pressure on sub-1x PBR companies makes conceivable but which nothing in the record points to.
findings.independence: The forecast dividend is unchanged at 25 yen in the Q1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260730502989.pdf).

findings.finding: The 20-day run-up of -5.9% is the mechanical ex-優待 unwind (September record date, last cum day 2026-09-28: 2,465, then -2.6% on 09-29 and a steady drift to 2,255) and does not show informed selling into the print. The disclosed short register is zero and unchanged.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Same set-up last year: the post-September ex-優待 drift ran into the 2025-10-29 H1 print, and the stock still fell 5.3% the next session. So the drift has not cushioned a print before.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a statement about what is already in the price: the decline is supply from 優待 holders and not a view on H1, so the drawdown does not mean the bad news is out. That leaves the effect near zero.
findings.independence: The 優待 record months (March and September) and the last cum-rights day 9/28 are listed at https://www.kabuyutai.com/kobetu/shintetsu.html

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none in three years at H1 (plans held at 74% and 70% progress and then beaten by 15% and 8.6%). This year's weak progress makes a downward cut the live tail; my estimate is about 20-25%. Returns: dividend action comes at Q3 by habit, so none expected now. New-year guide: not applicable (H1 print). Quarter against its own 進捗率: Q1 35% against 44-47% in prior years, H1 likely about 56% against 70-74% of plan and 62-65% of the actual full year.
baseline_tension: The priced lean is mildly positive (+0.34, almost all from the -5.9% run-up) and my lean is mildly negative, but the run-up is ex-優待 mechanics and not a view. The strongest positive this release could carry is the plan held again despite the weak Q1 (relief, 悪材料出尽くし after a 10% slide to PBR 0.69) or an out-of-pattern 増配 or buyback; I looked for any return action at H1 and found only the 2023 復配. So the call is close to an honest zero.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the progress-rate negative can be computed from the last 短信 by anyone, so the guidance finding went from -0.6 to -0.4 (what is left is only the chance of a cut) and p_up from 45 to 47; expected_move went from -0.22 to -0.13.
Rule 2: checked the strongest positive (plan held as relief, a surprise 増配 or buyback) and recorded it in baseline_tension; no change, because I had looked for returns before reading the file.
